title: introduce-location-aware-service-principal-assertions-and-audit-entropy
author: Maya Chen
description:
Context: Customer onboarding requests for region-restricted service principals and recent audit incidents revealed gaps in how principal attributes were propagated to downstream KMS routing and audit signing. This PR introduces a location-aware service-principal assertion model and increases entropy in audit signing to make header-level deduplication more robust while preserving existing RBAC v2 evaluation paths. Motivation: 1) Ensure RBAC decisions can be made using the originating service principal's declared location and its verified KMS affinity. 2) Prevent collision and replay in signed audit envelopes across tenants and regions by adding a low-cost entropy field into the audit signature payload. 3) Make KMS envelope routing tolerant of missing explicit region claims by falling back to an asserted principal location with configurable trust policies. Changes in this PR: - Add a new attribute 'principal.location' to service principal attestation and map it into RBAC v2 attribute sets. - Implement a location assertion verifier that consults configured identity providers and tenant allowlists; verifier emits a 'location_strength' metric. - Update KMS routing policy to check for explicit request-level kms.region, then principal.location, then tenant.fallthrough_region in that order. - Introduce AuditEntropySigner: adds a nonce and timestamp into audit signature preimage, signed with existing envelope keys. Nonce is deterministic-per-request-path+timestamp to keep envelope size small. - Add unit and integration tests covering attribute propagation, routing fallback, and audit envelope uniqueness. - Documentation: new security guide for operators on configuring principal trust levels and KMS routing precedence. Migration and rollout notes: The feature is behind an opt-in feature flag (feature.location_principals). Default behavior is unchanged. Rollout plan: enable in canary region for 48 hours, monitor location_strength and audit_signature_collision metrics, then progressive rollout. Checklist: - [x] Design doc reviewed by Security and Platform - [x] Unit tests added - [x] Integration tests added - [x] Metrics and dashboards updated - [x] Docs added - [x] Feature gated behind flag

High level implications: - No immediate breaking changes; policies that rely on principal claims will be able to opt into using principal.location selectors. - Enables more precise KMS region pinning for service principals when request-level region is absent. - Improves audit envelope resistance to accidental collisions in high-throughput tenants.

c9d12f4 kms: add routing precedence check and unit tests
d2f9a7b docs: operator guide for principal trust and routing
e7b5f11 telemetry: add location_strength and audit_signature_collision metrics
review_comments: Liam O'Connor: Why is the nonce deterministic? We discussed non-deterministic nonces for stronger replay resistance. Response: deterministicNonce combines request path + truncated timestamp to keep envelope size small while still avoiding same-path collisions; we also increment timestamp granularity. Added tests demonstrating reduced collision windows.

Priya Desai: Need clearer operator guidance when identity provider cannot assert location. Response: added section in docs with examples and feature flag to fallback to tenant-level region or fail-open/fail-closed options.
Evelyn Soto: CI failure on TestKMSRoute_when_no_region; fix by handling nil tenant.fallthrough_region. Response: added guard and new unit test.
release_notes: Added support for asserted service principal locations used by RBAC v2 and KMS routing. Introduced AuditEntropySigner to reduce audit envelope collisions. Feature is opt-in via 'feature.location_principals'. Operators should read the new security guide for configuration and migration steps.
notes_for_ops: 1) To enable: set feature.location_principals=true in operator config and restart authz service. 2) If identity provider cannot assert location, configure fallback: tenant.fallthrough_region or allow fail-open to use request region. 3) Monitor telemetry/secure-principal-location.json dashboard and watch 'audit_signature_collision' metric during rollout.
testing_summary: Unit tests cover attribute mapping, verifier edge cases, and audit signer nonces. Integration tests deployed to canary region simulating mixed identity providers. Observed zero collisions in 72h synthetic traffic test at 10k req/s for canary tenant.
